description: Reverse-ETL / audience activation: upload an upstream DataFrame into a Google Ads Customer Match user list via OfflineUserDataJobService. Identifiers (email/phone) are normalized and SHA-256 hashed before upload — never sent to Google in plaintext. Supports both 'add' (activation) and 'remove' (suppression) operations.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row contributes one or more hashed identifiers (email/phone) to the target Customer Match user list.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (job_resource_name / rows_submitted / rows_skipped_no_identifier / operation). Processing is asynchronous on Google's side — check Audience Manager -> Job History for per-row results.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

user_list_resource_name.label: User List Resource Name
user_list_resource_name.description: Target Customer Match user list's full resource name, e.g. 'customers/1234567890/userLists/987654321'. Must already exist.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> identifier type ('email' or 'phone'). Values are SHA-256 hashed before upload.

operation.label: Operation
operation.description: 'add' activates matching users; 'remove' suppresses them (e.g. exclude converted/churned customers).

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current date partition key.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current static partition value.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

name: Google Ads Customer Match Upsert
